title: Plan ARIA-V9 + V10 v3 — Autonomous Implementation + Learning + Endurance (4-validator-audit hardened)
trigger: V8 P+C+CR convergence-gate proven (14th live run produced two consecutive CONVERGED cycles T143056Z + T144139Z). V8 delivers logging + autonomy + verdicts but NOT professional implementations (CONVERGED plans never become real code), repo learning (each cycle stateless), real repo pressure (only git diff mined), skill genesis activation (V6.2 dormant), endurance verification (30-cycle gate ungated), or per-pattern cost telemetry. subfindings.title: Plan v3.1-E — Profile + preflight + budget SSoT (CLI argparse + set_profile SOC2 audit + ProfileGate.evaluate wire)
subfindings.note: CLI --profile expanded to all 5 PROFILES; --operator-approval-ref REQUIRED when --profile=autonomous (argparse-level rejection); --implementer-poll-seconds distinct from challenger_timeout_seconds (closes H-13). CLI flag != persisted profile routes through set_profile() so every transition writes a `runtime_profile_changed` audit row (closes C-2 SOC2 gap). run_autonomy_orchestrator.profile is REQUIRED kwarg (no default); orchestrator body has ZERO direct get_profile() calls — the kwarg is the cycle-execution SSoT (I-V31-E-04). 6 test callers migrated to inject profile='standard'. Preflight gate inside orchestrator: autonomous → fail-fast via GovernanceError + `autonomy_orchestrator_refused` event; strict → soft-warn via `preflight_strict_warnings` event. 6 V3.1-E invariants GREEN.

subfindings.title: Plan v3.1-B2 — Implementation phase follow-ups (verify wire + orphan reaper + additive cycle_id/pressure_source_type)
subfindings.note: verify_commit_signature wire landed at the trust boundary (plan_convergence_bridge._dispatch_implementation, NOT inside the git-agnostic kernel validator per its docstring contract). Cross-checks agent-claimed branch_tip_sha against signer_key_fp via `git verify-commit --raw` BEFORE record_implementation_outcome accepts the row; mismatch raises GovernanceError('commit_signature_unverified'). ARIA_DRY_RUN=true short-circuits the verify + emits commit_signature_verify_skipped_dry_run governance event. agent_invocations.create_agent_invocation_request gains additive cycle_id + pressure_source_type optional kwargs (no schema_version bump needed — additive optional fields don't require an upcaster). plan_convergence.scan_orphan_implementation_requests enumerates plans whose folded state ∈ {IMPLEMENTATION_REQUESTED, IMPLEMENTATION_IN_FLIGHT}; orchestrator startup hook reaps via record_implementation_rejected('orchestrator_restart_reaped_orphan'). 7 V3.1-B2 invariants GREEN (4 source-substring + 3 behavioral: empty-events, requested-orphan, in-flight-orphan, merged-state-filter). 3 full integration tests covering MERGED/REJECTED/TIMEOUT paths driving the full V9.2 state machine end-to-end are deferred to V3.1-B3 — the state-machine drive requires 10+ dependent event calls per path; the patched-fold approach in V3.1-B2 covers the scanner's filter logic which is the architectural-anchor-bearing surface.

subfindings.title: Plan v3.1-C2 — Memory hook orchestrator wire (MemoryHookImpl + record_convention ordering + verify_chain post-record + HUMAN_REQUIRED skill genesis)
subfindings.note: MemoryHookImpl production variant chains read_governance_rows_reverse(limit=200, kind_filter=convergence_resolved+pattern_signature_observed) → check_pattern_signature_stability → record_convention (if signer_key_fp valid) → verify_chain_or_quarantine → record_human_required(reason=skill_genesis_adapter_authoring) when stable=True. Order is Tier-1 anchored (V3.1-C HIGH-005: stability check BEFORE record, cycle's own row excluded from its own check; MEDIUM-012: verify AFTER record). Skill-genesis dispatch goes through HUMAN_REQUIRED (NOT direct registry.json write) so the operator reviews the adapter PR before activation (ai-safety HIGH-005). select_memory_hook factory dispatches observe/frozen → NoOp, standard/strict/autonomous → MemoryHookImpl. Orchestrator post-CONVERGED body (autonomy_orchestrator.py BEFORE specialist_review_started) invokes memory_hook.record() inside try/except so V10 memory pillar failure cannot block specialist_review + worker + auto_merge. memory_hook_recorded AutonomyState transition + memory_hook_failed governance event on exception. 7 V3.1-C2 invariants GREEN (4 source-ordering + 3 behavioral with patched primitives).

subfindings.title: Plan v3.1-D — Cost attribution wire (signed rows + drift detection + scoped token)
subfindings.note: D-5 record_cost_attribution row carries signer_key_fp (default 'SHA256:no-key' sentinel for legacy V8; cycle's ephemeral key fingerprint for V9+; closes H-5 cost ledger forgery defense-in-depth). D-3 drift detection: when estimated_input_tokens supplied and actual input_tokens differs by >50%, row gets drift_flag='usage_block_drift' AND emits usage_block_drift_rejected governance event AFTER row write (preserves ensure_tools_dir bootstrap order). D-4 scan_failing_ci gains gh_token kwarg + explicit env={'GH_TOKEN': scoped, 'PATH': ...} subprocess call when supplied — closes H-6 token scope (operator PAT no longer leaks to gh subprocess under autonomous profile; orchestrator mints READ_ACTIONS_ONLY scoped installation token + passes via kwarg). 6 V3.1-D invariants GREEN. Subfinding F-015-V31-D2 tracks the orchestrator-side cost_telemetry_hook wire (cycle_phases.cost_telemetry.record called from each LLM invocation site) + ci_executor _MOCK_MODE_AT_ENTRY frozen sentinel — primitives done, integration in V3.1-D2.

subfindings.title: Plan v3.1-D2 — CostTelemetryHookImpl + select_cost_telemetry_hook factory + CLI memory+cost wire + ci_executor frozen mock sentinel
subfindings.note: CostTelemetryHookImpl wraps budget.record_cost_attribution + threads envelope.invocation_role / model / tokens / pressure_source_type / signer_key_fp through to the cost-row write. Exception path swallows + emits cost_attribution_record_failed governance event so cycle main LLM call cannot be blocked by cost-row failures. select_cost_telemetry_hook factory matches V3.1-C2 dispatch (observe/frozen → NoOp; standard/strict/autonomous → Impl). CLI (cli.py autonomy run path) imports + invokes both select_memory_hook + select_cost_telemetry_hook + passes results via memory_hook= + cost_telemetry_hook= kwargs to run_autonomy_orchestrator — production V10 memory pillar + per-LLM cost attribution now activated by default for the 3 production profiles. ci_executor.py adds module-level _MOCK_MODE_AT_ENTRY sentinel (default None); main() entry captures the value ONCE via _is_mock_mode() so mid-run env mutation cannot flip mock decision between mint + record sites (closes ai-safety HIGH-007). 5 V3.1-D2 invariants GREEN. Subfinding F-015-V31-D3 tracks the per-LLM-call ci_executor.record_cost_attribution callsite wire after the claude CLI usage block parse — the architectural seam is wired but the actual usage extraction depends on the claude CLI response shape parsing which is operator-side observable + tracked separately.

subfindings.title: Plan v3.1-D3 — ci_executor LLM-call cost_telemetry_hook record + 5-site orchestrator call
subfindings.note: Architectural seams from V3.1-D2 that need per-LLM-call invocation: (1) ci_executor.main() AFTER successful claude CLI invocation: parse usage block (input_tokens, output_tokens) + call record_cost_attribution when _MOCK_MODE_AT_ENTRY is False; (2) orchestrator can call cost_telemetry_hook.record() at the 5 LLM invocation boundaries (Primary Plan / Challenger Plan / Cross-Review / Implementation / Specialist Review) once token usage is observable per-call. Both depend on the claude CLI response shape — operator-side observable + safer to land after V10.3-B 20-cycle endurance smoke confirms the cost-row volume is bounded.
